properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 10:06AM CDT until August 9 at 10:30AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
At 1006 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Cottage Grove,
or near Marshall, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Madison, Sun Prairie, Fitchburg, Stoughton, Waunakee, Verona, Oregon,
McFarland, Monona, Windsor, Edgerton, Columbus, Marshall, Deforest,
Cottage Grove, Belleville, Deerfield, Fall River, Shorewood Hills,
and Cambridge.

People attending Madison Ride the Drive  should seek safe shelter
immediately!
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1030 AM CDT FOR SOUTHEASTERN COLUMBIA AND EASTERN DANE COUNTIES

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 9:52AM CDT until August 9 at 10:45AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SVRMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Dodge County in southeastern Wisconsin...

* Until 1045 AM CDT.

* At 951 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Cambria, or
10 miles west of Beaver Dam, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated. At 936 AM, 50 mph winds were reported
just southwest of Kingston.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Beaver Dam, Waupun, Mayville, Horicon, Juneau, Lomira, Theresa,
Iron Ridge, Burnett, Fox Lake, Woodland, Brownsville, Kekoskee,
Atwater, Astico, Knowles, South Beaver Dam, Minnesota Junction, and
Leipsig.

Other landmarks included are the following Location Horicon Marsh.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
